title: Tournament status
noCheckIn: No check-in. When you start, everyone registered enters the bracket.
checkInOpen: When you start, only players who checked in enter the bracket.
finished: Results can still be corrected on each match's page.
closeCheckInConfirm: Close check-in? The tournament goes back to registration, and check-ins already made stay.
startConfirm: Start the tournament? Registrations and check-ins freeze, and players who didn't check in are left out.
startConfirmCount: Start the tournament? {in, plural, =0 {No one enters} one {# registered player enters} other {# registered players enter}} the bracket and {out, plural, =0 {no one is left out} one {# is left out (no check-in)} other {# are left out (no check-in)}}. Registrations and check-ins freeze.
startConfirmNoCheckIn: Start the tournament? {count, plural, one {# registered player enters} other {# registered players enter}} the bracket and registrations freeze.
notEnoughCheckIn: To start, at least {min} players must have checked in; {count, plural, =0 {no one has yet} one {only # has} other {only # have}}.
notEnough: To start, at least {min} registered players are needed; {count, plural, =0 {there are none yet} one {there is only #} other {there are only #}}.
undoStartConfirm: Undo the start? The tournament goes back to check-in, with the registered players, check-ins, and seeding as they were. Players who withdrew or left the community are removed from registrations.
undoStartConfirmNoCheckIn: Undo the start? The tournament goes back to registration, with the registered players and seeding as they were. Players who withdrew or left the community are removed from registrations.
undoStartResults: {count, plural, =0 {No game has been submitted yet.} one {The games and the result of # match will be erased, along with the match history.} other {The games and the results of # matches will be erased, along with the match history.}}
noCheckInTdm: No check-in. When you start, the formed teams enter the bracket and reserves are left out.
checkInOpenTdm: When you start, only complete teams enter the bracket, once everyone on them has checked in.
startConfirmTeams: Start the tournament? {teams, plural, =0 {No team enters} one {# team enters} other {# teams enter}} the bracket and {reserves, plural, =0 {no one is left as a reserve} one {# player is left as a reserve} other {# players are left as reserves}}. Registrations, check-ins, and teams freeze; after that, only substitutions.
teamsIncomplete: {count, plural, one {# team is incomplete} other {# teams are incomplete}}. Complete the teams (or move players to reserve) before starting.
teamsIncompleteCheckIn: {count, plural, one {# team is incomplete or has someone without check-in} other {# teams are incomplete or have someone without check-in}}. Adjust the teams before starting.
notEnoughTeams: To start, at least {min} complete teams are needed; {count, plural, =0 {there are none yet} one {there is only #} other {there are only #}}.
